purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Official MC Sadiqabad publishes a 2025-2026 city base-map PDF whose legend explicitly includes Parcel Boundary. The official Rahim Yar Khan revenue page lists Sadiqabad's Arazi Record Center and Shahbaz Pur Qanungoi center. The official PULSE viewer exposes a cadastral Parcels layer and current ArcGIS configuration, but anonymous service metadata and a bounded ID-plus-geometry query returned HTTP 200 with ArcGIS code 499 Token Required. No token was requested or used, and no polygon response was retained.
registryAssessment: Local registry/map evidence is present through the official municipal parcel-boundary base map, with district revenue material establishing the local land-record custodian context. This is not proof of legal title scope or complete citywide vector coverage.
